scientific_integrity: The reduction and complete standalone finite certificate establish the theorem and its sharp counterexample as presented. No external audit or authorship is represented.

No efficient normal-form length bound or extension to arbitrary many agents, temporal fixpoints, or graded modalities.
Proof reduces infinite frames to a finite 3-world case and then uses the included exhaustive checker; expert-independent validation is not claimed.
Historical equivalently phrased finite-rank normal forms may exist.
title: Sharp depth-three normalization on binary-branching weakly transitive frames
